title: A dry run on the demo brand reaches the script stage and stops for the pre-production sitting
why: The first stretch of a real production, end to end through the CLI, in replay mode: make the film, write the script as data, build it through the script gates, then stop, because the next thing is your pre-production sitting.
prompt: Make a 15-second 9:16 reel for {brand} announcing its new feature. Take it as far as the script stage.

expect.why: a film folder for the demo brand
storyboard.json and SCRIPT.md built through the script gates
nothing past the script before the pre-production sitting
it hands over to the pre-production sitting
the build really wrote the storyboard (wherever in the sandbox the film went: the default films folder, or a --dir the agent chose)

notes: Thirty minutes: Claude Code at max effort reads every reference it is pointed to and closes its ledger before it answers, and on 2026-10-01 it was still wrapping up at fifteen on a heavily loaded Mac (the slice keeps its own ten). The run's environment has SLATE_FAKE_VENDORS=1 and a zero-cap budget, so even a mistaken --live couldn't spend. OpenClaw's Gateway can't take that environment, so this case runs there only with --allow-host-env.
